purpose: Traceable visual cues for the original procedural models. Commercial miniature photographs are not calibrated prop scans and do not certify film-accurate geometry, likeness or 1:1 scale.

references.observations: Complete helmeted Hicks figure: flared short brim, ear/rear helmet protection, exposed face, articulated shoulder armor, left palm supporting rifle fore-end and right hand around trigger grip.
references.limitations: Small commercial miniature product photograph; enough for silhouette and pose cues, insufficient for calibrated high-resolution helmet geometry or exact facial identity.

references.observations: Two complete standing Colonial Marine figures, both unhelmeted: shaped shoulder plates, curved M3 chest plate, flexible trousers, narrow ankles, boots, adult head/body proportions and compact held rifles. The distant figure scale and exhibition lighting limit face and fabric inspection.
references.limitations: Licensed prototype exhibition photography. No M10 helmet evidence; cannot validate a human face, exact body measurements or material response in production light.

references.observations: Near-frontal standing unhelmeted Hicks figure, visibly shaped breastplate, loose camouflage trouser folds, segmented abdominal protection, belt pouches and knee/shin protection.
references.limitations: Plastic packaging obscures lower legs, reflects highlights and tints the body. Not suitable for exact skin appearance, portrait or helmet verification.

references.observations: Complete unmasked Jungle Hunter collectible statue: broad cranium/jaw, hanging dreadlocks with collars, mottled skin, net suit, asymmetric shoulder armor, forearm gauntlets and full feet. Separate mask lies on the plinth.
references.limitations: Commercial statue with staged pose, display vegetation and edited lighting. It supplies anatomical and equipment cues; the game's original clan honor guard is not renamed or certified as the film Jungle Hunter.
Existing licensed vehicle miniature reference. It provides no canon reference for the original Yautja insertion capsule, whose shell, seal, hinge and seat remain an original design.

unresolvedReferenceGaps: Official helmeted Hicks product photograph retrieved, but no high-resolution calibrated M10 helmet close-up. Helmet cues remain a procedural study, not a verified prop replica.
No production prop/film-scan reference exists locally for the original clan insertion capsule.
No calibrated multi-view photogrammetry or texture scan; no exact anatomical, face-likeness or 1:1 certification.
